description: This file defines the ApiController class in the SuiteCRM API v8 module. It handles generating JSON API responses and error handling, including content negotiation and request validation. It also specifies version info and integrates with various SuiteCRM utilities and dependencies.

classes.name: ApiController
classes.description: Main controller class for handling SuiteCRM v8 API JSON responses, including validation, error handling, versioning, and content negotiation.

methods.name: generateJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Constructs and validates a JSON API response payload, handling errors and setting appropriate headers and status codes.

methods.name: handleExceptionIntoPayloadError
methods.description: Converts an exception into a JSON API error object and appends it to the payload errors.

methods.name: generateJsonApiErrorResponse
methods.description: Creates a JSON API error response from an exception, including detailed logging and error object creation.

methods.name: negotiatedJsonApiContent
methods.description: Performs content-type and accept header validation, ensuring proper media types for JSON API.

methods.name: validateRequestWithJsonApiSchema
methods.description: Validates incoming JSON request payloads against the JSON API schema using schema validation.

methods.name: getVersionMajor
methods.description: Returns the major version of the API.

methods.name: getVersionMinor
methods.description: Returns the minor version of the API.

methods.name: getVersionPatch
methods.description: Returns the patch version of the API.

methods.name: getVersionStability
methods.description: Returns the stability status (e.g., ALPHA) of the API version.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger instance used by this controller for logging activities.
